heading: Thursday, October 10, 2024
topLine: Meta transformers find new global Lyapunov functions.

items.headline: Meta transformers find new global Lyapunov functions
items.summary: Alberto Alfarano, François Charton (Meta) and Amaury Hayat trained sequence-to-sequence transformers on synthetic data built from random solutions. The models then found Lyapunov functions that certify global stability of dynamical systems, a problem with no known general method. They report that the models beat algorithmic solvers and humans on polynomial systems, and found new Lyapunov functions for some non-polynomial systems. Each candidate function can be checked independently. The paper was peer-reviewed and published at NeurIPS 2024.
